 "info": [
  {
   "field": "identity_values",
   "about": "Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address, plus the name or email used to look up the customer",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of these: date of birth, email, phone number or address?",
   "may_hold_back": false
  },
  {
   "field": "deposit_amount",
   "about": "How much the customer will put into the new savings account",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "How much do you plan to deposit into the savings account?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "holding_pattern",
   "about": "Whether the balance stays the same for the year or the customer plans deposits or withdrawals",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Will you add to or withdraw from the savings account during the year, or leave the deposit untouched?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "needs_paper_statements",
   "about": "Whether the customer needs paper statements mailed. This rules out accounts that require paperless statements and adds paper-statement fees",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Do you need paper statements mailed to you, or are electronic statements fine?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "credit_score",
   "about": "The customer's approximate credit score, used to check each card's minimum score. The customer may not know it or may decline to say",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "What is your approximate credit score?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "card_preferences",
   "about": "Any limits on which cards the customer will accept (for example, refusing cards with no credit-score requirement) and the expected monthly spending",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Are there any kinds of credit cards you would or would not want? Roughly how much do you expect to spend on the card each month?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "rho_bank_plus_subscription",
   "about": "Whether the customer has a Rho-Bank+ subscription. The Gold Rewards Card requires one, and the apply tool asks for it",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Do you have a Rho-Bank+ subscription?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "open_to_new_checking",
   "about": "Whether the customer would open another checking account to get a linked-checking APY boost. If they refuse, no boost that needs a new checking account is counted",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Would you consider opening a different checking account, or should I only look at a savings account and a credit card?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "annual_income",
   "about": "The income the customer enters on their own card application",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "For the card application, what is your annual income?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "existing_accounts",
   "about": "The customer's checking and savings accounts: class, status, balance and date opened",
   "from": "records",
   "ask": "",
   "may_hold_back": false
  },
  {
   "field": "existing_credit_cards",
   "about": "Any Rho-Bank credit cards the customer already holds. Only the highest card APY bonus applies",
   "from": "records",
   "ask": "",
   "may_hold_back": false
  },
  {
   "field": "open_to_credit_card",
   "about": "Whether the customer will apply for a Rho-Bank credit card to raise the savings APY",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Some Rho-Bank credit cards add bonus APY to savings. Would you consider applying for a card?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "card_required_features",
   "about": "Features a recommended card must have, such as travel insurance",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Are there any features the card must have, such as travel insurance?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "wants_new_checking",
   "about": "Whether the customer also wants a new checking account (for example to replace a basic one) as part of the combination",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Would you also like a new checking account as part of this, or keep your current one?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "checking_required_features",
   "about": "Features the new checking account must have, such as early direct deposit",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Are there any features your new checking account must have, for example early direct deposit?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "max_minimum_balance_acceptable",
   "about": "The highest ongoing minimum balance the customer can keep in savings",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Is it fine if the savings account has a minimum balance requirement, and up to what amount?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  },
  {
   "field": "date_of_birth",
   "about": "Read from the record to check checking-account age limits",
   "from": "records",
   "ask": "",

   "field": "savings_required_features",

   "ask": "Are there any features your savings account must have, such as reimbursement of out-of-network ATM fees?",

   "about": "Whether the new checking account must offer overdraft protection that draws from a linked savings account, and whether a per-transfer fee is acceptable",
   "from": "customer",
   "ask": "Do you need overdraft protection on the new checking account that pulls from a linked savings account, and is a small per-transfer fee acceptable?",
   "may_hold_back": true
  }
